label: Hero paragraph
text: Welcome to our multicultural, multiethnic, and multigenerational church! We are thrilled to have you join our vibrant community. Here, you will find a place of belonging and support, where diverse backgrounds come together to share in faith and fellowship.

label: Who We Are paragraph
text: We can't wait to grow together and embrace the unique gifts each person brings.

label: Parking
text: Park without rushing and find a seat. Our X-Edge team is out on Sunday mornings to guide you in and send you toward the right door.

label: What To Wear
text: Come as you are. You'll see jeans and you'll see suits, and God sees the same thing in both. There's no dress code here - we mean it.

label: When To Arrive
text: Arrive a little early and have time for fellowship. Meet a few faces, settle in, and share a moment together before the first song.

label: Serve intro
text: Join our congregation in making a difference. We're seeking passionate volunteers to fill key roles and help our ministries thrive.

label: Connect Groups intro
text: Where real people build real faith. Don't do life alone - do life together.

label: Creative Arts intro
text: Every song, every screen, every sound. Creative Arts is the group of teams that serve together to make Sunday happen - each one its own department, all of them one department.

label: Classes intro
text: Go deeper at your own pace. Classes and studies you can start whenever you are ready.
